title: astrology occultation: the params of scene.play

x.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, east to the left.

y.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, north up.

on.description: When this step shows: 0.3 + 5.4 i / 14 for step i.

off.description: When the next step takes over (the last one: 6).

path.description: The Moon against the planet in 14 steps, 2.2 hours either side of the closest moment. Scale: 0.45 over the Moon's angular radius.

planet.description: The planet it covers: venus, mars, jupiter or saturn.
